content: In this paper we integrate a boundary assembling step with an LSTM module and a CRF module for Named Entity Recognition in Chinese social media text. With the abundance of social media information, our work is timely and desirable. The improvement in experiment results over existing methods clearly shows the effectiveness of our approach.
